h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Faridabad

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Faridabad

c: Faridabad's sector parks are run by resident welfare associations, and many of them want an open-air gym beside the walking path. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to RWAs, group housing societies, schools, industrial units and municipal parks across Faridabad. We build each machine at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,100 km away, and send it to Haryana by road.

An RWA usually has a fixed budget and a committee to convince. We make that easier with a layout drawing that shows each machine, its clear space and the overall area, together with a clear quote. Once the committee approves, we manufacture and our installation team or a dealer in the NCR installs the machines. Park soil usually suits grouting, while a paved corner can take self-standing bases.

items.q: Can you prepare a layout for our RWA committee meeting?
items.a: Yes. Send us the park size and photos. We will send a layout drawing with each machine and its clear space, plus a quote, so the committee can approve it in one meeting.

items.q: How many people can use the 8 Station Multi Gym?
items.a: It has eight exercise points on one frame, so up to eight people can train at the same time, one at each station. It suits busy parks where people arrive in groups.

items.q: Do you install outdoor gyms in Faridabad?
items.a: Yes. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in the NCR, grouted or self-standing depending on the surface.
